entry.title: New: Resolution 726 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO HAWAI‘I FARMERS UNION FOUNDATION

Approves a grant of $56,900 to Hawai‘i Farmers Union Foundation, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to support ongoing maintenance efforts and to develop a management plan at the Banyan Trees Park, North Kohala, property (Tax Map Key: 5-5-015:042), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.
